name: Kasugano Haruka
source:
With a gentle appearance and slim profile, in many ways Haruka is the spitting image of his [url=/c553]sister[/url], as befits identical twins of the opposite sex. Personable and honest, he forges lasting friendships with remarkable ease. Haruka copes with the loss of his parents with a stout heart, burdened with the knowledge that the future of his delicate sister is dependent to his own. Yet to grasp success he believes one must acknowledge the past, and to that end searches for answers to his plight.

[Edited from [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20150331123620/http://www.erogereview.com/2009/02/16/yosuga-no-sora/]Nargrakhan's review[/url].]
